title: From biofuels to e-fuels: an assessment of techno-economic and environmental performance
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5SE00786K, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Etienne de Chambost, Louis Merceron, Guillaume Boissonnet
An integrated literature review and process simulation framework is used to compare biofuel, e-biofuel and e-fuel pathways in terms of carbon conversion, energy efficiency, costs, and life-cycle GHG emissions.
